bootstrap: The pinned installer selects the first worktree and the reference-transaction script requires a checkout top-level. A minimal private non-bare hook host provides that checkout, pinned scripts, and isolated Git config, hooks and main ref.
cleanup: Both linked checkouts are removed via git worktree remove --force in LIFO order before PASS emission.
edit_checkout: git worktree add --detach --no-checkout under the same isolated scratch-local Git repository
historical_receipt_scope: Binds the prior seal. Current complete check requires the current seal. The already-filed receipt remains historical.
seed_checkout: git worktree add --detach under an isolated scratch-local Git repository
validation: Python compile for current and prior run.py and job.py
Bash syntax check for current and prior launch.sh
Current and prior seal consistency and historical native receipt SHA-256
Both legacy seed paths are absent
